global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F (thin divider lines, highlighted word), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (serif headline, pills, brush band, right box), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE (left box), white #FFFFFF. Secondary for this variation: soft warm cream #FBF3EC background with a subtle silk texture.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium editorial supplement ad with two real photos in rounded cards and the real bottle photoreal and sharp.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Elegant, trustworthy and aspirational; soft daylight.
global_identity.graphic_language: Thin fuchsia lines framing the headline, rounded photo cards with pill labels, circular arrow badge, diagonal dry-brush band, two rounded info boxes side by side.
global_identity.text_typography: Product-name headline in a heavy elegant high-contrast serif (only this line); subtitle in spaced uppercase geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Bold look); labels and boxes in heavy uppercase sans-serif.

creative_objective: Show slim women who feel nothing goes to their hips that a believable change is possible with the 3-month plan: the product name big, the same woman on Day 1 and Month 3, and the 3-bottle treatment with pay on delivery, keeping the exact F34 structure without inventing prices.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the serif product-name headline, 2) the two photo cards, 3) the bottle, 4) the brush band, 5) the two info boxes, 6) the registration line.
art_direction.composition_style: Top 25%: centered serif headline between thin fuchsia lines and a spaced subtitle. Middle 50%: left 60% two rounded photo cards side by side with pill labels on top and a round arrow badge between them; right 40% the bottle standing large. Bottom 25%: left a diagonal dry-brush band; right two rounded boxes side by side separated by a thin line; a thin registration line at the very bottom.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Symmetric, airy, premium spacing; photo cards equal size; bottle slightly overlapping the bottom zone.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft daylight on the photos; studio light on the bottle with a soft shadow on the cream surface.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

Bottom-left: a diagonal dark plum dry-brush band with a giant white 'X3' and the treatment text. Bottom-right: a pale blush box and a dark plum box side by side separated by a thin vertical line. Very bottom: one thin line with the registration.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium editorial supplement ad on a warm cream #FBF3EC background with a very subtle silk texture. TOP 25%: centered, the product name as a huge heavy dark plum #2B1226 high-contrast serif headline, framed above and below by thin hot-fuchsia #E6177F lines; under it one line of spaced uppercase dark plum sans-serif subtitle with the last words in fuchsia. Nothing above the headline, no logo. MIDDLE 50%: on the left 60%, two equal rounded photo cards side by side, each with a dark plum pill label with white text sitting on its top edge, and a round dark plum badge with a white arrow between the two cards. LEFT CARD: a real slim Latina woman in her mid-twenties photographed from behind, from the waist to mid-thigh, wearing heather-gray leggings and a loose white tee, indoors at home with soft window light; her hips look straight and her glutes flat. RIGHT CARD: the same woman on another day, wearing medium-blue high-waisted jeans and a fitted black top, on a sunny city sidewalk, same framing from behind; her hips look more defined and her glutes rounder and fuller, a believable natural difference. Tasteful and non-explicit. On the right 40%, the large real product bottle standing upright with a soft shadow on the cream surface, razor sharp: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; black label with the small pink VITALABH emblem, the huge bold white word 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', the small line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra', a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' joined by plus signs, and '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)'. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. BOTTOM 25%: on the left, a diagonal dark plum dry-brush paint band with a giant white 'X3' and the treatment words in white beside it; on the right, two rounded boxes side by side separated by a thin vertical line: a pale blush #FBE3EE box with dark plum text and a dark plum box with white text. At the very bottom, centered, one thin line of small dark plum text with the registration. No prices anywhere. Do not add a logo, price, percentage, button, stars or any extra text.
